Validate Playbook main-push run 36228860402 completed successfully, including unit tests, structural checker, exact-commit handoff preparation, and artifact upload.

The run published artifact astrology-core-handoff-0d736dc5d5eaf59b05ee0d5f2fe0e39d1ecb0ad2 (artifact id 10901344879, 175897 bytes) with GitHub digest sha256:c572c9c739675963268cf1378eee88587d7a243e4c9c022bab35fa9ba7e1435d.

GitHub connector download_workflow_artifact returned a connector-backed file reference; Files intentional rematerialization placed the ZIP at /mnt/data/astrology-handoff-smoke-current-main-v2/astrology-core-handoff.zip.
Execution-container SHA-256 of the rematerialized ZIP exactly matched the GitHub artifact digest.
The ZIP contained HANDOFF_MANIFEST.json, PLAYBOOK_COMMIT, runtime/astrology/CHATGPT_DETERMINISTIC_CORE_BUNDLE.json, and tools/build_astrology_core_bundle.py.
HANDOFF_MANIFEST.json parsed as valid JSON; source_repository and playbook_commit matched the expected repository and exact main commit; PLAYBOOK_COMMIT also matched exactly.
Every manifest-listed payload file matched its declared byte_size and SHA-256.
The artifact-contained canonical bundle verifier returned zero errors with compare_project=false.

The canonical materializer reconstructed 12 runtime/dependency files, wrote a verified cache marker bound to the exact playbook commit, and verified archive SHA-256 0e2fa80fa9a7bfacde612723e3f19cb6dd28261e5c01d4f7f43d353b85dd736b.

With PYTHONPATH limited to the materialized cache and Python invoked with -S, a synthetic natal request using explicit coordinates plus Asia/Taipei returned status=admitted and interpretation_allowed=true.

The resulting natal fact bundle used provider astronomy-engine-natal-v1 version 1.3.0 with fact_source=approved_provider and calculation_verification=verified_provider; the natal runtime gate returned status=admitted with no errors.
classification_reason: PASS. The current-main publishing enhancement closed the observed availability gap: after verified cache miss and absent direct repo-file bridge, a successful exact-main validation run now exposes a connector-backed artifact that can be downloaded without repository mutation, rematerialized to the execution filesystem, verified against GitHub artifact digest plus exact commit/manifest identities, passed through the existing canonical bundle integrity gate, and executed in an isolated Python environment. Existing bounded opaque chunk transport remains the fallback when the temporary artifact is absent, expired, or invalid.
repair_history: Initial implementation PR #251 merged at ec2294457778eb99105e012136d7f6fdc8755e2b and successfully published an artifact, but the first smoke test found HANDOFF_MANIFEST.json ended with a literal backslash-n sequence and was invalid JSON.

Bounded repair PR #252 replaced the manifest writer with print(json.dumps(...), file=...) and strengthened the discoverability regression; main advanced to 0d736dc5d5eaf59b05ee0d5f2fe0e39d1ecb0ad2 before this successful formal follow-up.
